descriptionByLocale.it:
Are you knowledgeable of hedge fund strategies, able to spot market trends and have a passion for investing? Are you looking for an environment with a combination of technical in-depth research work and high-profile relationship management? We’re looking for a Research Analyst to:
• source and evaluate hedge funds across strategies with a focus on global macro, fixed income relative value, commodities and systematic macro/CTAs
• identify risk and opportunities across funds and themes, top down and bottom up and carry out day-to-day investment monitoring
• manage important fund relationships with a focus on monthly qualitative and quantitative monitoring
• support the strategy/regional Heads manager and market analysis, gathering data, and preparing commentaries as part of our investment process and/or client requests
• use other skills and innovative thinking to drive fund analytics and process improvements.
